reason: The note's firm findings each concern a single paper: the Q ZI-C floor (about \(0.96\) against reported LLM efficiencies of \(0.36\) to \(0.91\), conditional on prompt compliance), and arithmetic on P's reported aggregates (exact counts, McNemar ranges, and a first-pass-accept bound that also rests on an unverified fixed per-call token model with \(c > 1000\)); the Q-P institution-versus-agent decomposition is still an untested analogy. The verifier has twice asked for the matched P ablation, and this authorised round again could not supply it: P's code, task list, per-task outcomes and traces are not public, and Sonnet 4.5 runs were excluded. The free gemma4:26b runs have produced no result and would test a different model on different tasks, so a human must decide whether to obtain from P's authors the per-task LCB outcomes and first-pass accept count split by whether \(v_0\) passes (or their harness, task list and budget for paired Sonnet 4.5 runs of R-only iterate-to-clean, AR and a rate-matched random critic), or to let the roughly 10-hour local runs finish, knowing they speak only to gemma4:26b and not to P or the cross-paper link.
